common_symptoms: heartburn, chest pain, regurgitation, difficulty swallowing
complications: esophageal stricture, Barrett's esophagus, esophageal cancer
drugs: omeprazole, ranitidine, proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), H2 receptor antagonists (H2RAs)
epidemiology: common in adults, more prevalent in males
risk_factors: family_history || obesity || smoking || alcohol_consumption || sedentary_lifestyle || unhealthy_diet
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers, disease mimics
treatment_challenges: drug resistance, frequent relapse, side effects, poor adherence
